CONTRACT (read first). Repo Cognition-Partner-Workshops/otterworks, base branch tp-run/databricks-20260914T183234Z; one PR per unit into that branch, never main/tech-partnerships; PR bodies never name or email the requester. Read .migration/00_context.md, 01_conventions.md, 03_recon_tolerances.{md,json}, allowed_targets.json, docs/migration/P1_monthly_invoicing_analysis.md (your unit rows, dictionary, recon plan) and P1_monthly_invoicing_plan.md (decisions D2-1..D10-11 as DECIDED at STOP C). Never edit .migration/. Run factory-doctor --role child --expect-identity 2e90bc1d-e9a1-4703-8c48-ad28ebb1864d --expect-host https://dbc-8bc9474f-40ae.cloud.databricks.com --expect-catalogs ow_tp,databricks_postgres first (databricks_postgres is the Lakebase database name dbx-recon needs as --target-catalog; it is not a UC catalog, DEC-C4); any mismatch -> report BLOCKED and stop. Skills: oracle-plsql, target-routing -> databricks-lakebase, data-reconciliation, tp-pre-pr-self-check. Oracle is read-only (secret name ORACLE_OW_BILLING_RO_DSN via AWS Secrets Manager ow-tp/oracle/ow_billing_ro; never print it); every live source read is pinned AS OF SCN and you get ONE live read per unit (2 statements). Lakebase: project ow-tp-billing, write ONLY to your batch branch below (create from its parent with TTL 7d; credential via `databricks postgres generate-database-credential`, authenticated as the migration service principal dhrov_spa via OAuth M2M using the DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID/DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET secrets with DATABRICKS_DEMO_HOST; never use the PAT (DATABRICKS_DEMO_TOKEN) for any Databricks or Lakebase call); never touch branch production. Databricks: catalog ow_tp only, serverless warehouse 565cd2fd713738c4, no clusters, everything prefixed ow_tp_, ns=demo. Fixture first (`make tp-smoke`, tp-validate-contracts, tp-validate-schemas), then one live dbx-recon run --mode transactional --target-kind lakebase --depth full; result.json on the PR is the merge authority (make tp-validate-recon). Caps: 3 review rounds, 3 full recon re-runs, then escalate. Report back: PR links, result.json paths, SCN pin, branch name, cost actuals.
BATCH w3-b1, unit U4 invoicing-credits (XL: open a ~100-line contract/decision PR first — signatures, composite types, tax/credit rules, recon exclusions — then the implementation PR). Lakebase branch mig-p1-w3-b1 from the merged wave-2 branch mig-p1-w2-b1 (U0-U3 inherited). U4 invoicing-credits: tables INVOICES (FK tenants, rating_periods), INVOICE_LINES (UQ invoice_id,line_no; FK ON DELETE CASCADE), CREDIT_NOTES; PKG_INVOICING -> type invoicing.preview_t (plan_code, plan_fee, overage, tax, credit), invoicing.compute_preview(text,date,date) RETURNS invoicing.preview_t (calls rating.compute_rating, sums open credit notes, tenant tax exemption, TAX_RATE 0.0825 constant), invoicing.fn_invoice_preview RETURNS TABLE (5 lines: plan, usage, regional tax, local tax = g_tax/2 each unrounded until column insert, credit), invoicing.fn_invoice_lines(text) RETURNS TABLE, invoicing.sp_issue_invoice(text,date,date): deterministic period/invoice ids, CALL rating.sp_finalize_rating, upsert invoices, delete+rebuild invoice_lines from the preview, subtotal/tax/credit/total, credit burn-down oldest-first preserving the documented double-decrement quirk verbatim (R11: keep intermediates unconstrained numeric). NO notification emission (D7-2 option B). New surfaces, fixture-tested only and excluded from source recon: invoicing.close_billing_period(date,date) (per-tenant savepoint, failures logged via util.log_msg, never swallowed) and invoicing.issue_credit_note(text,text,date,numeric) (D4-6). Recon tiers 1,2 (SUM(total), SUM(remaining_amount)),3 (INVOICE_LINES has 2 rows vs 3 invoices at source: compare as-is, never repair, R15),4 dual-run fn_invoice_preview per tenant/period at the pin and sp_issue_invoice idempotency on a fixture copy (second run identical rows),5,7. Declared source rows at pin: INVOICES 3, INVOICE_LINES 2, CREDIT_NOTES 5. mapping_spec: invoices watermark issued_at; invoice_lines, credit_notes none (strict). PRs ow_tp_u4_invoicing_contract, ow_tp_u4_invoicing_credits. TIER 6 (D10-12, DEC-C4a): the CDC read path is a host-side Kafka sink on the Oracle host writing Debezium change events as newline JSON to /Volumes/ow_tp/bronze/landing/cdc/<TABLE>/ (parent implements via the Databricks Files API as the SP; no public 9092). Tier 6 reads that landing (lag = event source_ts vs applied_at, ordering by SCN per PK, cdc_lag_max_s 60) only after the parent confirms it is populated; otherwise record Tier 6 skipped/no_cdc. Never read Kafka directly.
